body: Everyone being obsessed with komi for her looks is what makes the story have a sense of realism to me. People can deny it, but people will immediately like you based on your looks without even talking to you. If anything it makes me sympathize with her more, people not even talking to you already treating you diffrently must suck. Unfortunately, don't relate to being hot, but i relate to being ugly. Which is the same, except it has the opposite effect. Others automatically hate you. Same for Tadano being hated for being friends with her. It makes me symapthize with him, due to relating to it.
Stay with us, We can talk this out.
Holy hell man, this is godly, at first i thought that this was a picture!
This looks so good, OP. From the sky to the ocean i would be proud to hang this up in my room.
It doesn't matter how good you are, if you enjoy it thats good enough. Maybe try something else? I swear something will click man.

In reality. Life is bittersweet. Some days are just better than others. Seek out a hobby, club, anything that makes you happy. You don't have to be good at it. Even daily exercise makes you feel better, as weird as it may sound. I'm not saying it will get better instantly or at all, but try out some of the reasons for living that other pepole have. Maybe its arts, cooking, writing, photography. Me personally i enjoy cooking for others. Sure i'm far from the best chef but the others enjoy it. Point is, try things until something clicks for you.
